d:
Enjoy the evergreen Bollywood song "Sab Pyaar Mohabbat Jhooth" from the movie Meri Biwi Ka Jawab Nahin, featuring Akshay Kumar and Sridevi. Sung beautifully by Kavita Krishnamurthy, with melodious music composed by Laxmikant-Pyarelal and lyrics penned by Anand Bakshi, this song brings back the magic of classic Bollywood music.
Relive the nostalgia of timeless Hindi film songs and enjoy this memorable musical composition!
Song Credits:
Song: Sab Pyaar Mohabbat Jhooth
Singer: Kavita Krishnamurthy
Music: Laxmikant-Pyarelal
Lyrics: Anand Bakshi
Movie: Meri Biwi Ka Jawab Nahin
